props.heading: You could build this.
props.lede: This page was assembled from blocks — drag them, edit them, or ask the AI to rework the whole thing.

props.title: Blocks that look like the site.
props.body:
Every block uses the site's own design, so anything you build here looks like it belongs.

Open the builder, drag a block in from the left, and click any text to edit it in the panel.

cards.title: Drag
cards.text: Pull a new block in from the left panel.

cards.title: Edit
cards.text: Click a block and change its words on the right.

cards.title: Ask AI
cards.text: Type what you want in the bar up top and watch the page change.

props.text: Come as you are — leave transformed.
